summary: Date/location reconciliation for OCHA/NAD road-stoning injury components.
discovery_sources: OCHA; NAD monthly/daily reporting; PSNA; Daily Blog
resolution_notes: Date ambiguity narrowed without guessing. NAD/PSNA reporting places the named Deir Istiya driver injury (Muhammad Sami Abu Rabi) on Mar. 26. OCHA's separate Mar. 27 road-stoning injury aggregate explicitly concerns roads near Nablus and Ramallah, so it should not be mapped to Deir Istiya in Salfit or used as independent corroboration for this candidate. The Mar. 26 Deir Istiya lead remains Unresolved because independent same-event corroboration beyond the Palestinian monitoring lineage was not recovered. Mar. 19 Al-Maarajat/Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur remains separately canonical as ILPV-2023-0323.
media_status: No exact same-event media recovered; no substitute used.
